item.title: Coast Guard language on swastikas, nooses clarified, then Senate confirms Admiral Kevin Lunday as chief
item.description: Courtesy: CBS Washington — The Senate confirmed Admiral Kevin Lunday as Coast Guard commandant Thursday night after agency guidance on the display of hate symbols such as swastikas and nooses was clarified. Democrats objecting to the guidance had been holding up the confirmation. Senate Majority Leader John Thune, of South Dakota, called for and got senators to approve Lunday unanimously...

item.title: Hamilton County school board adopts growth policy
item.description: HAMILTON COUNTY, Tenn. (WDEF)- The Hamilton County School Board has adopted a policy pertaining to how new development will affect school zones.
